6910: St. Martin Parish campground at Butte La Rose in the Atchafalaya Basin, with a boat launch on the bayou and paved sites with fire rings lined up along the water; one site has 50-amp power and the rest 30-amp. --Claude
6927: Overnight RV park run by Streamside off I-20 at Monroe, beside a small lake on the property, with big-rig pull-throughs and a game room; the laundry is open 24 hours. --Claude
6942: Family RV park run by Streamside on LA 16 at Amite City, by Natalbany Creek and around an 8.7-acre stocked lake, with concrete sites for big rigs, a heated pool, mini-golf, cabins and a dog park. --Claude
6956: Evangeline Parish Police Jury recreation area by a 400-acre lake, with a swimming beach and boat launches. --Claude
6960: Revitalized 72-acre destination campground near Mount Hermon, with room for big rigs, a pool, a stocked pond, a creek, ATV and mud trails and an event pavilion; it hosts rally weekends.  111 sites have full hookups and 144 water and 30-amp power, and there are more than 20 tent sites. --Claude
6967: Former motor court on the Cajun Prairie east of Eunice, now a 16-room motel with RV sites, a stocked fishing pond, a pool and a playground. --Claude
7205: City of Brady park on Brady Lake, the city's reservoir, which has about 25 miles of shoreline.  There are 23 RV hookups in the Park area and more in the Pavilion area, 15 tent sites and 3 primitive ones, cabins, screened cabanas, restrooms with showers, boat ramps, a pavilion and a shooting range. --Claude
7296: City of Brady park of 44 shaded acres by Brady Creek, with restrooms, a pavilion, a show barn and disc golf.  A camper may stay at most 20 days a year. --Claude
7357: Small, shaded in-town RV park in Atlanta, in northeast Texas near US 59, with a pavilion, a fire pit and grills; the laundry is open 24 hours, and stays can be nightly, weekly or monthly. --Claude
7379: RV park by Bastrop Bayou south of Angleton, about 20 minutes from the Surfside and Freeport beaches, with extra-wide sites and short and long stays. --Claude
7388: Country RV park on a hill off Highway 87 about 2 miles from downtown Center and 20 minutes from Toledo Bend Reservoir, with 60-foot sites, furnished cabins and boat-trailer storage. --Claude
7390: RV park in Port O'Connor a few blocks from the bay and the beaches, with gravel and concrete pads, a clubhouse, a bathhouse, propane, a stocked fishing pond and trailers for rent. --Claude
7402: Coastal RV resort in Rockport, formerly Watersedge RV Park, across the road from Aransas Bay, with sites for every size of rig, a 500-foot fishing pier for guests, a pool and a clubhouse. --Claude
7410: Large RV resort south of San Antonio off I-37 near Braunig Lake, with cabins, a pool and a 5-acre lake on the property with a fishing pier. --Claude
7489: RV park in Crosby, opened in 2018, with a dog wash, walking trails and a pond, for short and long stays. --Claude
7510: Coastal RV resort off Highway 35 between Rockport and Aransas Pass, with concrete streets and pads, cable TV, a bathhouse and daily, weekly and monthly stays; there is a boat ramp on Aransas Bay nearby. --Claude
7518: Marina RV park on Lake Palestine about 10 minutes south of Chandler, with back-in sites with fire rings, most of them with full hookups and some on the water where you can pull a boat up to the pad.  The marina sells bait and has a double boat launch, covered and open slips and a fish-cleaning station; the gate is coded, and there are tent sites and 2 cabins. --Claude
7520: Camper's World RV park inside the historic Fort Clark Springs community at Brackettville, open to travelers as well as members, with level pea-gravel sites under live oaks and a community room.  Guests can use the spring-fed Las Moras Springs pool, the 18-hole golf course and the trails on the fort grounds. --Claude
